description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5340015433587 CLAMP,LOOP: Line 0001 Qty 5403 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0017 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
